notes.title: Check out the new demo for Frogspin, a platformer all about mayhem where you spin to win
notes.content:
Frogspin is an upcoming roguelike platformer where you spin to win, which results in some absolute mayhem as every level begins with the pull of a lever.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/check-out-the-new-demo-for-frogspin-a-platformer-all-about-mayhem-where-you-spin-to-win/

notes.title: Frogspin is a chaotic platformer where you spin a slot machine for crazy level modifiers
notes.content:
Frogspin pulled my in by the colourful and inviting sweet visuals but reading more into it, the game sounds like it becomes pure hilarious chaos due to the slot machine modifier mechanics.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/frogspin-is-a-chaotic-platformer-where-you-spin-a-slot-machine-for-crazy-level-modifiers/
